name: Moments
source:
Sol's the kid who sits in the back row and never talks. The type who's not very good at school but not very good at anything else either. Quiet, passive, without anything to say because he's afraid of saying the wrong thing.

Then he catches Chet stealing test answers.

Or: a repressed rich kid meets a cheating soccer player.

[From [url=https://arbitrrrary.itch.io/moments]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
索尔就是那种坐在教室最后一排、从不说话的孩子。学习不怎么好，其他方面也谈不上擅长。安静、被动，因为害怕说错话，便索性什么也不说。

直到他撞见切特偷考试答案。

或者说：一个压抑自己的富家子弟，遇上了一个作弊的足球少年。

[摘自[url=https://arbitrrrary.itch.io/moments]Itch.io[/url]]
